candidate.name: SDSSJ1402+6321
candidate.selection_reason: first residual-blind candidate among the seven all-pre-pixel-gate passers in the frozen all-14 SLACS-KCWI screen
selection_variables: rerunnable Project Dinos inputs and model products
public raw KCWI exposure and same-night calibration identities
forbidden_selection_variables: published dark-matter fraction or density slope
residual under GR, RAR, U0, or any negative-gravity model
post-download image or kinematic fit quality

acquisition.download_policy: stream every file to a partial path, verify identity and size where locked, compute SHA-256, then atomically rename; never overwrite a verified receipt

Dinos_GitHub.identity_check: expected byte count plus Git blob SHA-1; record an independent SHA-256 on receipt

Dinos_full_output.identity_check: file ID and name must match; record exact byte count and SHA-256 on first successful receipt because the provider does not publish a cryptographic checksum

calibration_compatibility.bias_and_flat: same optical setup and same TUP/0 detector readout as the science frames
calibration_compatibility.continuum_bar_and_arc: same optical setup but ALL/1 detector readout rather than science TUP/0
calibration_compatibility.required_validation: the official DRP must accept the frozen continuum/arc frames and yield wavelength residuals within threshold; detector-readout mismatch is not waived or relabeled as an exact match
calibration_compatibility.fallback: if the geometry frames fail, stop KCWI promotion and publish the calibration shortfall; do not substitute a later-night set after seeing the kinematics

independent_HST_metadata.role: provenance cross-check only; the initial replay uses the checksum-locked Dinos processed images
independent_HST_metadata.trigger: download calibrated/raw MAST products only if the Dinos image provenance or pixel scale cannot be verified from the locked HDF5 and configuration

lens_replay_gate.software: rerun the public Project Dinos configuration at the locked repository commit and inspect the locked full-chain output
lens_replay_gate.published_posterior_role: nuisance initialization and replay control only; the published power-law slope, dark-matter fraction, and GR mass posterior are not response data
must_reproduce: all three image arrays, masks or common mask construction, PSFs, pixel scales, and noise conventions
the declared model components and priors in the locked configuration
a finite full-chain posterior and posterior-predictive images in all fitted bands
lens_replay_gate.stop_if: the public images, PSFs, mask, configuration, and chain cannot be put in one verified coordinate system or do not close predictively

lens_response_basis.quantity: theory-free radial reduced-deflection perturbation in the image plane
lens_response_basis.basis: natural cubic radial splines, zero at the origin and at 1.5 Einstein radii, unit amplitude at one knot
lens_response_basis.derivative: symmetric central finite difference of the full PSF-convolved three-band forward model with the frozen nuisance projection

lens_light: constant and linear sky per band
nuisance_projection.method: whiten by the pixel covariance/noise model, then project each response column through the regularized Schur complement of the full nuisance Jacobian
nuisance_projection.reason_source_positivity_not_used: an active inequality boundary can create artificial local rank

lens_variant_grid.negative_control: replace every radial deflection column by its 90-degree tangential quadrature while preserving amplitude and radial support

KCWI_reduction_and_dynamics_gate.reduction: official KCWI DRP with propagated variance and data-quality arrays, using only the frozen science/calibration identities
KCWI_reduction_and_dynamics_gate.kinematic_extraction: Voronoi-bin the registered cube to target continuum S/N 30 and fit stellar velocity and dispersion with template and polynomial systematics
KCWI_reduction_and_dynamics_gate.stop_if: fewer than three stable covariance-bearing bins overlap the retained lens-response support

execution_order: acquire and checksum all locked Dinos GitHub inputs and the locked full-chain output
acquire and checksum the four KCWI science frames, 27 calibration frames, and five standard-star frames
validate HDF5/config coordinates and replay the published imaging likelihood
require predictive closure before evaluating any response derivative
compute the frozen nuisance-marginalized lens Jacobian and all controls
reduce KCWI and construct the covariance-bearing kinematic map
apply the joint three-lens-mode plus three-dynamics-bin gate
only after the joint gate, freeze a separate dynamical-potential and Weyl-potential reconstruction protocol

concrete_outcomes.advance: At least three lens-response singular modes pass every frozen rank, stability, injection, negative-control, and held-out test, and at least three stable covariance-bearing KCWI bins overlap those modes. This promotes J1402 only to a same-system observable candidate and authorizes a separately frozen Phi versus Phi+Psi reconstruction.
concrete_outcomes.partial: Record the stable lens rank and usable KCWI-bin count, but do not count J1402 if either side is below three.
concrete_outcomes.fail: Any coordinate/replay failure, calibration failure, synthetic-coverage failure, negative-control rank, or fewer than three stable modes/bins ends J1402 promotion without weakening thresholds.
concrete_outcomes.rethink_checkpoint: If J1402 becomes the third consecutive external system with zero structural promotion after J0946 and E325, stop single-system acquisition and reconsider the ten-system premise/data requirement before selecting another target.
